question: Using the inverse-matrix method, solve $x+2y=4$ and $3x+5y=11$, and determine $\frac{x}{y}$.
explanation:
Step 1: Form the matrix equation
Here, $$A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&5\end{bmatrix},\quad X=\begin{bmatrix}x\\y\end{bmatrix},\quad B=\begin{bmatrix}4\\11\end{bmatrix}$$
Step 2: Calculate the inverse
Since $|A|=5-6=-1$, $$A^{-1}=\begin{bmatrix}-5&2\\3&-1\end{bmatrix}$$
Step 3: Find $X$
Therefore, $$X=A^{-1}B=\begin{bmatrix}-5&2\\3&-1\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}4\\11\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}2\\1\end{bmatrix}$$
Step 4: Calculate the ratio
Hence, $$\frac{x}{y}=\frac{2}{1}=2$$
